response.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), with_all AS (SELECT p.*, AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) OVER () AS overall_avg FROM per_type p) SELECT MediaTypeName, avg_unit_price, avg_bytes_per_ms, avg_bytes_per_ms / overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall_avg FROM with_all WHERE overall_avg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Keeping 'large files' means Track.Bytes strictly greater than 10323804.

The 'plain average across all the media types' is the unweighted average of the per-media-type averages of Bytes/Milliseconds (each media type counts once), not an average over individual tracks. Media types are grouped by MediaTypeId and Name.
Media types with no tracks passing the size filter do not appear. Bytes/Milliseconds uses floating-point division, and a zero Milliseconds gives a missing value that the averages ignore.

alternatives.interpretation: The threshold is inclusive: keep tracks with Bytes >= 10323804.
